name: app-blue-persona-with-metrics-cards-slide
title: Blue Persona with Metric Cards
whatItIs: A pale slide titled User Personas with a stacked-card portrait on blue, dashed-ruled Goals, Pain Points and Behavior blocks, a quote and three white metric cards with a half-disc, a ring and a gradient bar.
whatItMeans: Dotted rules and stacked photo cards feel neat and human, and the bright blue links everything.
techniques: Stacked offset card behind the portrait
Centred headings with small grey descriptions
Bold key phrase within a light sentence
Varied mini charts in white cards

vocabulary.definition: Offset layers peeking from behind a card.
A dotted rule separating content blocks.
A circle with a number beside a section name.
